<DESCRIPTION>EXHIBIT 10.10
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.10</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>THIRD POINT PRIVATE CAPITAL PARTNERS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>MULTIPLE CLASS PLAN</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 175.15pt 0pt 175.25pt; text-align: center">December 12, 2025</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">This Multiple Class
Plan (this &ldquo;<I>Plan</I>&rdquo;) is adopted pursuant to Rule 18f-3(d) under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &ldquo;<I>1940
Act</I>&rdquo;), by Third Point Private Capital Partners, a Delaware statutory trust (the &ldquo;<I>Fund</I>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 175.15pt 0pt 175.25pt; text-align: center"><U>WITNESSETH</U>:&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Fund is a
closed-end management investment company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
the Fund intends to rely on exemptive relief from the Securities and Exchange Commission that permits it to issue multiple classes of
shares, and one of the conditions of this relief is that the Fund must comply with the provisions of Rule 18f-3 under the 1940 Act as
though such rule applied to closed-end investment companies;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the shares of
beneficial interest of the Fund (the &ldquo;<I>Shares</I>&rdquo;) are divided into one or more separate classes;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Fund desires
to adopt this Plan in order that the Fund may issue multiple classes of Shares (each, a &ldquo;<I>Class</I>&rdquo;); and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
the Board of Trustees of the Fund (the &ldquo;<I>Board</I>&rdquo;, and each member, a &ldquo;<I>Trustee</I>&rdquo;), including a majority
of the Trustees who are not &ldquo;interested persons&rdquo; (as defined by the 1940 Act) of the Fund (the &ldquo;<I>Independent Trustees</I>&rdquo;),
in considering whether the Fund should adopt and implement this Plan, has evaluated such information and considered such pertinent factors
as it deemed necessary to undertake an informed evaluation of this Plan and determination as to whether this Plan should be adopted and
implemented, and has determined that the adoption and implementation of this Plan, including the expense allocation contemplated herein,
are in the best interests of each Class individually, as well as the best interests of the Fund;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify"><B>NOW THEREFORE</B>, the Fund
adopts this Plan pursuant to Rule 18f-3 under the 1940 Act, on the following terms and conditions:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>The effective date of this Plan (the &ldquo;<I>Effective Date</I>&rdquo;) shall be such date as the Board may specify.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">2.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>The Fund may issue Shares in one or more Classes, as set forth in Exhibit A. Shares so issued will have the rights and preferences
set forth in the Fund&rsquo;s Amended and Restated Agreement and Declaration of Trust and bylaws (each as amended from time to time),
any applicable resolutions adopted by the Board from time to time and the Fund&rsquo;s then current confidential private placement memorandum
(the &ldquo;<I>PPM</I>&rdquo;) relating to the Classes.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1; Options: NewSection -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->1<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Shares
issued in Classes will be issued subject to, and in accordance with, the terms of Rule 18f-3 under the 1940 Act, including, without limitation:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 22.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>each
Class will have a different arrangement for shareholder services or the distribution of Shares or both, and will pay all of the expenses
of that arrangement, as set forth in Exhibit A;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(b)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>each
Class may pay a different share of other expenses, not including advisory or custodial fees or other expenses related to the management
of the Fund&rsquo;s assets, if these expenses are actually incurred in a different amount by that Class, or if the Class receives services
of a different kind or to a different degree than other Classes;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(c)</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;each Class will have exclusive voting rights on any matter submitted to shareholders that relates solely to its arrangement;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(d)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>each
Class will have separate voting rights on any matter submitted to shareholders in which the interests of one Class differ from the interests
of any other Class;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(e)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>except
as otherwise permitted under Rule 18f-3 under the 1940 Act, each Class will have the same rights and obligations as each other Class;
and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(f)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Shares
of one Class may be exchanged, at the shareholder&rsquo;s option, for Shares of another class of the Fund (an &ldquo;intra-Fund exchange&rdquo;),
if and to the extent an applicable intra-Fund exchange privilege is disclosed in the Fund&rsquo;s PPM, as amended or supplemented from
time to time, and subject to the terms and conditions (including the imposition or waiver of any sales load, repurchase fee or early withdrawal
charge) set forth in the PPM, provided that the shareholder requesting the intra-Fund exchange meets the eligibility requirements of the
Class into which such shareholder seeks to exchange.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 27.85pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 21.1pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27.85pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">4.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>Nothing in this Plan will be deemed to require the Fund to take any action contrary to its Amended and Restated Agreement
and Declaration of Trust or bylaws, each as amended from time to time, or any applicable statutory or regulatory requirement to which
it is subject or by which it is bound, or to relieve or deprive the Board of the responsibility for and control of the conduct of the
affairs of the Fund.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27.85pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">5.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>This Plan will continue in effect indefinitely unless terminated by a vote of the Board.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 27.85pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">6.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>This Plan may be amended at any time by the Board, provided that any material amendment of this Plan will be effective only
upon approval by a vote of the Board, and a majority of the Independent Trustees.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 0; text-indent: 27pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">7.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>This Plan will be construed in accordance with the internal laws of the State of Delaware and the applicable provisions
of the 1940 Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 5.85pt; text-indent: 22pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 44.5pt 0pt 0; text-indent: 27pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">8.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT></FONT>If any provision of this Plan is held or made invalid by a court decision, statute, rule or otherwise, the remainder of
this Plan will not be affected thereby.&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
